title: Ace Needs His Own One Piece Spin-Off Anime
content:
Fire Fist Portgas D. Ace’s tragic death at Marineford eliminated one of One Piece ‘s fan-favorite characters almost 700 episodes before its current timeline . Monkey D. Luffy lost a key piece of his family when Admiral Akainu killed his adopted brother. Unlike a lot of manga and anime, he didn’t return either. There was no resuscitation, a multiverse, or anything to bring him back and that’s what makes that scene so shocking and captivating after all these years.

However, two small novels ( One Piece Ace’s Story: Formation of the Spade Pirates and One Piece Ace’s Story: New World ) released in 2018 and gave fans a prequel glimpse of Ace’s life and ascension to captain of the Spade Pirates. Eiichiro Oda didn’t write the stories, but was involved in the supervision of the project. This means that the story sits in the official canon timeline. Although no content is set up for Ace’s future, the prequel stories give an opportunity to detail his past on screen. One Piece ‘s next movie should absolutely make these two volumes into a film, or even create a short series that can go beyond the novels.

Ace Of Flames Changes Family Legacy

A bit of a spoiler alert, but the two novels quickly tell how Ace and the Spade Pirates came to be . The first novel explores Ace’s upbringing and pirate roots going back to his father Gol D. Roger. Ace and his first crew member Deuce are stranded on an island, but eventually escape through building a ship, but not before Ace unknowingly eats the Flame-Flame Fruit to gain his powers.

The duo eventually escape and from there and begin a journey much like his brother’s. Ace is a pirate, but certainly doesn’t act like one. In the novels, he regularly goes out of his way to help the innocent and even rivals like Marine Ensign Isuka. His behavior dispels any notion that he’s exactly like his father. In fact, he commits wholeheartedly to showing everyone around him that his heritage doesn’t define him. Ace wants to chart his own path to pirate glory.

A Heroic Life Cut Short Deserves More Lore

The dichotomy in Ace’s and Luffy’s approaches is what makes anime like One Piece so intriguing, and their characters so likable . While they’re pirates, which is usually synonymous with heinous acts like pillaging and murdering, both protect the vulnerable, show deep loyalty to their friends and family, and are only guilty of fighting and resisting establishment authority.

His father’s life was cut short for his many crimes, but Ace’s was ended for defending his brother. One Piece fans continue to follow Luffy’s journey to the top of the pirating world, but lost the chance to see how Ace’s career would turn out. It only makes sense that they’d at least get to see the genesis of his pirate life. Would you like to see more Ace content in One Piece ? Let us know in the comments.

title: Pokémon’s First Movie Is Still Peak Even After 27 Years
content:
With the number of anime series and movies Pokémon has released over the years, fans often find themselves celebrating major milestones throughout the year. However, there’s something special about the first movie that just can’t be beat. Pokémon has released several anime seasons, movies, card games, video games, manga, and more, all of which contributed to the long-standing popularity of the franchise. For many 1990s kids, the series is a nostalgic childhood memory as it takes the viewers into a fantasy world full of unique and adorable creatures. Based on the popular 1996 video game, the renowned Japanese animation studio OLM released an anime series a year later.

The story primarily follows Ash Ketchum on his journey to become the greatest Pokémon master ever, but later on, several spin-offs also focused on other characters. Every new season or movie of the story takes fans on a completely new adventure regardless of whether it’s a film or a season. The anime has released 23 movies over the decades, but the first one can’t be compared with anything else. Pokémon: The First Movie – Mewtwo Strikes Back premiered in the U.S. on November 12th, 1999, more than a year after the Japanese premiere. It’s been 27 years since the anime movie was introduced to fans in the U.S., and it’s now considered a timeless classic with a plot and storytelling that new fans can enjoy even now.

What Is the First Pokémon Movie About?

Directed by Kunihiko Yuyama, the film was initially released in Japan before making its English debut for fans in the U.S. It’s based on an original story set outside of the TV anime show, which was airing the Indigo League at the time of the original release in 1998. However, the story was still connected to the main plot as it took a short detour during the journey of Ash Ketchum and his friends. While on his way to compete in the World-Class Tournament, Ash’s group crossed paths with Mew and Mewtwo, two legendary Pokémon . Both of these Pokémons were introduced for the first time in the franchise’s history and later became iconic thanks to the movie’s popularity.

The movie reveals that Team Rocket managed to create the first successful clone by using the fossil of the Legendary Pokémon Mew. The story primarily centers around the clone, who was named Mewtwo, a man-made version of one of the most powerful creatures of all time that quickly becomes aware of the circumstances it was created under. After waking up, Mewtwo realizes that its creators only see it as a weapon and goes on a rampage. It fled after destroying the laboratory but crossed paths with Sakaki, the leader of Team Rocket, who manipulates the cloned Pokémon into committing all kinds of atrocities.

It doesn’t take long for Mewtwo to become repulsed by the cruelty of mankind and isolate itself. Mewtwo tries to plot against humans while also hoping to find its true purpose in life. While disguising itself as the world’s strongest Pokémon trainer, Mewtwo accepts the challenges from new trainers from across the regions. However, Mewtwo’s life begins to shift when it encounters Ash and the others who will do anything to stop it from destroying humanity.

Pokémon: The First Movie – Mewtwo Strikes Back Still Holds Up Today

The movie was released when the anime was at the peak of its popularity , which is why it helped pave the path for the franchise’s long-time success. Not only that, but the plot and the character depth of Mewtwo can never get boring no matter how many times you watch it. Although the movie was marketed towards a young audience, it portrayed profound philosophical depth, which was pretty unexpected considering the movie was based on an original story. Mewtwo Strikes Back isn’t simply loved for its original storytelling, but because of the complex themes it explored.

Ash’s sacrifice and the heartbreaking reaction of Pikachu are still considered one of the saddest moments in the entire series. Not to mention that Mewtwo later became a considerably crucial character in the franchise’s history, which is all the more reason why the film’s legacy carried on even now. It may not be objectively the best anime movie of the franchise since fan preferences can vary depending on many factors. However, whether it’s nostalgia, the classic animation style of the 1990s, the movie will always be irreplaceable.

Do you think the first movie is still the best after all these years, or do you have another personal favorite? Let us know in the comments below!

title: Sega Streams Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond Short Animated Film on YouTube
content:
Sega beagn streaming on Thursday the full Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond 35th anniversary short film :

Dr. Eggman's new evil scheme is to upgrade Metal Sonic into the ultimate fighting machine by stealing Sonic's life-data and harnessing the power of the Chaos Emeralds. Sonic and his friends realize that to defeat Metal Sonic they must rely on the friendship they built through their adventures.

An animation project for the Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game debuted in August 2025.

Netflix and Sega are producing a new children's animated series for the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise . The new show is targeted towards upper preschoolers.

The Sonic Prime animated series debuted on Netflix in December 2022 with one 40-minute episode and seven 20-minute episodes. Netflix streamed the third season in January 2024.

The live-action Sonic the Hedgehog 4 film is scheduled for a March 19, 2027 release. The franchise is also receiving a fifth film in 2028.

title: Goten & Trunks Need Their Redemption in Dragon Ball Super’s Anime Future
content:
Early in their fighting careers it looked like Trunks and Goten were on track to surpass their fathers and take up the mantle of protecting earth in the Dragon Ball universe. Instead, they faded into the background, while Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo and sometimes Gohan continued to raise their respective power levels . The young half-Saiyans certainly don’t lack ability. In fact, both achieved Super Saiyan well before their fathers, but they keep getting reduced to side characters or comic relief.

Their most recent appearance in Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero proved that exactly right. The duo attempted to do their Fusion Dance to assist in the battle against Cell Max, but one slip of the finger messed up the fusion and created an overweight Gotenks. Yet again, another opportunity to prove their worth as fighters fell to the wayside. Both are capable of much more but don’t get many chances to prove otherwise. In the next release, the franchise should finally cut them loose and give them a shot at redemption. Gohan got his last time out . It’s time for the two younger Saiyans to get a shot.

Past Showcases The Duo’s Shortcomings

The one time Goten and Trunks got to headline a fight, it was a mixed bag. They were young kids at the time faced with the impossible task of battling Majin Buu. They managed to successfully fuse and immediately tried to arrogantly take on Buu in Gotenks’ base form. Although they carried immense power, they were not prepared for Buu’s regeneration, and he eventually overwhelmed them. Still, the successful fusion and power level they reached set a new bar for young fighters.

Unfortunately for the citizens of earth, the mistake cost everyone dearly. Majin Buu ended up creating Evil Buu when he became upset and released the evil energy in his body. Evil Buu then consumed Majin Buu to create Super Buu, who is a much stronger, violent and ill-intentioned version of Buu. Gotenks’ mistake gives enough time for the whole situation to coalesce. Gotenks held his own against Super Buu, and even ascended to Super Saiyan 3, which was an incredible feat.

Vegito didn’t even showcase that ability in the Buu saga. Goku just accomplished that in the same arc, but they’re significantly younger. Despite the great show of power and growth, the point is that it could’ve been prevented with some patience and training. This isn’t their fault, as it was a huge ask for two young fighters. In the end, Buu proved too much, and they were defeated.

It’s the only time the two really got an opportunity to fight on the main card. They’ve lost out basically ever since when it comes to the plot-heavy fights. Those bouts are passed to the heavy hitters from the beginning of the series, but there’s no doubt that a day is coming where they’ll be called upon again.

Saiyan Sons Could Be Franchise Future

Trunks and Goten are the perfect vessels to carry the series forward when Goku and Vegeta tire of their fighting days, which hopefully last a long time. But being realistic in thinking about the potential future of the series, there couldn’t be a better way to move it forward. Goten wears his hair exactly like his old man and behaves like him more than his older brother. Trunks might look more like Bulma, but he’s got his father’s cockiness and fighting prowess.

The difference between these two and their fathers is that they’ve tried to live a mostly normal life. Chi-Chi and Bulma prefer a life without violence, but they also know that the fighting spirit is within anyone with Saiyan blood. It obviously didn’t fully work with Gohan, and Chi-Chi focused heavily on his education. He still knows how to tap into his abilities as seen in Super Hero .

A different aspect to tap into could focus on how Goten and Trunks came up in different circumstances as fighters . For the most part, they saw far less action than Gohan. He got forced into action at an even younger age and had the fate of the world on his shoulders numerous times. Goten and Trunks only had the Buu saga as their moment of high stakes. The rest of the time focused on peace, so it’s a different angle. What do you think? Should Goten and Trunks get more fights in the future? Let us know in the comments.

title: Professor Layton and The New World of Steam Game Reveals English Dub, Cast
content:
The dub stars Christopher Robin Miller as Professor Layton and Lani Minella as Luke, both reprising their roles from the franchise 's previous games.

New English cast members include:

• Amber Lee Connors as Elinora and Elida

• Nic Olsen as Eggmuffin

• Andy Barnett as Bolt Allinston

• Caleb Jensen as Sheriff Bobsley

• Arthur Romeo as Falcon

• Kayli Mills as Mystella

The game will launch on December 10 worldwide for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam. There is mouse support for all versions except Switch.

The game was previously slated for last year, but was delayed .

The game takes place after the events of Professor Layton and the Unwound Future , the franchise 's third Nintendo DS game. The setting is Steam Bison, America, where Luke has moved to and has invited Layton to visit. Yō Ōizumi returns to voice Layton, and Mio Imada is the new voice of Luke Triton.

The additional cast includes:

• Riho Yoshioka as Elinora and Elida

• Mahiro Takasugi as Eggmuffin

• Shin'ya Kote as Bolt Allinston

• Kōichi Yamadera as Sheriff Bobsley

• Akio Ōtsuka as Falcon

• Michaela Wako Sato as Mystella

Quiz Knock, a group specialized in creating puzzles and riddles for media, are in charge of the game's puzzles.

Joe Hisaishi ( Studio Ghibli films) is composing the theme song performed by Lilas.

Professor Layton and the Curious Village ( Layton Kyōju to Fushigi na Machi ) game is getting a remake for Switch 2, Switch, PS5, and PC via Steam in 2027.

Layton's Mystery Journey: Katrielle and the Millionaire's Journey was the previous entry in the series. The game launched in Japan for Nintendo 3DS and worldwide for iOS and Android devices in July 2017. The game then launched for Nintendo 3DS in the West in October 2017. The game launched for the Switch in August 2018, and that version headed West in November 2019. The original game inspired the Layton Mystery Tanteisha: Katori no Nazotoki File television anime , which premiered in April 2018, and ended in March 2019.

title: Disney to Premiere Lilas Dreams & Memories Documentary About YOASOBI's Lilas Ikuta on December 30
content:
Disney revealed on Thursday that Lilas Dreams & Memories , an original two-part documentary about the YOASOBI duo's singer-songwriter Lilas Ikuta (also known as ikura ), will stream on Disney+ and air on Disney Channel on December 30. The documentary centers on ikura and her experience with Disney's High School Musical films. The company streamed a trailer for the Japanese version Ikuta Lilas Dreams & Memories , which debuted on November 7.

Disney also streamed a video of ikura performing a cover of the "Start of Something New" song from the 2006 High School Musical film:

In related news, YOASOBI debuted their new song "KILLA" and streamed a live performance video. The duo is currently on their "SUPER PLANET" tour for Japan, Asia, and now, Australia.

YOASOBI is a musical duo comprising composer Ayase and singer-songwriter ikura ( Lilas Ikuta ). Ayase , who had begun composing using the Hatsune Miku Vocaloid software in 2018, collaborated with ikura in 2019, formed the duo, and they released their first single "Yoru ni Kakeru" in December 2019. The single became a viral hit inside and outside Japan, and was a breakout success for the duo. YOASOBI performed both the opening and ending theme songs for the second season of the BEASTARS anime, and also performed the opening theme song "Shukufuku" for the Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury anime. The duo's next breakout hit was the song "Idol" for the Oshi no Ko anime in 2023. The song has broken multiple records in Japan and abroad. The duo performed the opening theme song "Yūsha" for the Frieren: Beyond Journey's End anime.

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game Adds Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture's Laocorn on November 19
content:
SNK announced on Thursday that its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game will add the Season Pass 3 DLC character Laocorn Gaudeamus from the Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture anime film on November 19. The company streamed a trailer for Laocorn as well as a digest movie about the 1994 anime film:

Season 3 launched on July 23 with six characters joining the roster. Rick Strowd joined the game on July 23. Duck King launched on August 27. Kim Kaphwan joined the game's roster on September 24. Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from the Tokyo Revengers anime joined the game as Season 3 DLC characters on October 22. The game will add Reina in December.

The game's crossover with Street Fighter includes characters Ken and Chun-Li. Both characters are a part of the game's Season Pass 1. BIG in December 2025.

Kim Jae Hoon, the first DLC character for the game's Season Pass 2, launched on January 22. Nightmare Geese launched on February 26, and Blue Mary debuted on March 26. Wolfgang Krauser debuted in the game on April 24, coinciding with the game's first anniversary. DLC character Mr. Karate launched on May 27. Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star debuted in the game on June 28.

The game added real-life DJ Salvatore Ganacci, professional soccer player Cristiano Ronaldo, and Hokutomaru. Other returning characters include Terry Bogard, Rock Howard, Tizoc, Hotaru Futaba, Marco Rodrigues, B. Jenet, Kevin Rian, Billy Kane, Mai Shiranui, Kim Dong Hwan, and Gato. The game also includes the new characters Preecha and Vox Reaper.

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Casts Kenji Yamauchi, Ken Uo
content:
The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, revealed two new cast members on Thursday:

• Yōhei Azakami as Shirō Yamaoka

• Hitomi Sasaki as Yūko Kurita

• Akio Ōtsuka as Yūzan Kaibara

• Tōru Furusawa as Hideo Tanimura

• Kōsuke Echigoya as Tomio Tomii

• Nobuo Tobita as Taizō

• Hiroshi Naka as Kyōichi Koizumi

• Kyō Yaoya as Kinue Arakawa

• Hiroko Ushida as Noriko Mitani

Ken'ichi Nishida ( Good Bye, Dragon Life , Papuwa , Poka Poka Mori no Rascal ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Reincarnated as a Sword two seasons, Plannosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu Bu ) is in charge of series scripts, and Nozomi Kawashige ( Good Bye, Dragon Life ) is designing the characters. Shinei Animation is in charge of production.

Yui Makino will perform the opening theme song "PROMISE ME," and the band Skoop on Somebody will perform the ending theme song "Akashi" (Proof).

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th compiled book volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014. Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials. The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.

title: Kakao Piccoma Launches New 'Lulumiru' BL Webtoon Platform
content:
The service is available on web browsers on smartphones, tablets, and PCs. Membership is free and readers can purchase works chapter by chapter. Lulumiru hosts both new series and older series that have had lasting popularity.

The service also has a search function that lets users omit certain characteristics and tags that they do not like, and also a "top x bottom" search function that allows users to choose certain characteristics they want to see in each member of a romantic pairing.

Kakao Piccoma is hosting large-scale advertisements for the new service in Ikebukuro in Tokyo from November 9 through November 22.

Kakao Piccoma currently operates the Piccoma service in Japan, which offers webtoons, web manga, and web novels.

The new Lulumiru service launches less than two months since Kakao Entertainment announced in late September it would shut down its North American webtoon platform Tapas , marking the end a major part of its direct platform strategy in the region five years after investing about 1.1 trillion won (about US$780 million) to acquire Tapas and webnovel platform Radish.

Tapas will end its service on March 31, 2027.

In South Korea, Kakao Entertainment plans to consolidate its two webtoon platforms, Kakao Page and Kakao Webtoon, into a single platform centered on Kakao Page by the end of the year. The company plans to bring together the platforms' content, user data and about 16,000 original IPs.

title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Game Announces New, Earlier February 4 Release Date
content:
The staff for Square Enix 's Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United , a remake of the 1995 Romancing SaGa 3 game, announced on Thursday that the game's release has been moved to February 4 (February 5 for Steam ), over a week earlier than its original February 16 launch. The game's Digital Deluxe version will also have an early access release on February 1 (February 2 for Steam ). The game's staff noted that with the change of release date, those who pre-ordered the game's digital version for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 will have their orders canceled, and would need to place a new order. The game's producer Shinichi Tatsuke stated the game's new release date and pre-order details in an announcement video. The below video has no English subtitles, but announcement details are in English in the video description box:

The game will release for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . The remake features 3D graphics, refined gameplay, newly arranged music, and voice acting. The game features eight protagonists (Mikhail, Monika, Katarina, Khalid, Julian, Thomas, Sarah, Ellen), 20 recruitable companions, and the "Glimmer" system for acquiring new abilities.

Square Enix describes the story:

Set in a world caught in a devastating cosmic cycle known as the Rise of Morastrum, which occurs once every 300 years and claims the life of everyone born that year except a single survivor known as the Child of Destiny, players will choose between eight heroes bound by fate. A little over a dozen years after the last disaster, the Four Sinistrals have returned, seeking to reopen the Abyss Gates and bring ruin to the world. On their journey to save the world, players can choose which lands to visit, which stories to pursue and the order in which to confront the Sinistrals, ensuring a unique adventure with every playthrough.

Romancing SaGa 3 debuted for Super Famicom in 1995. The remastered version of the game launched for PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Switch, Xbox One, PC, iOS, and Android in November 2019.

The Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven HD remake game launched digitally for Switch, PS5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam , as well as physically for Switch and PS5, in October 2024. The game got a Switch 2 Edition in August 2025.

Square released the first Romancing SaGa game in 1992 for the Super Famicom (SNES) game console. An enhanced remake of the game for the PlayStation 2 titled Romancing SaGa: Minstrel Song launched in Japan and North America in 2005. A ported version of the original Super Famicom game launched for mobile phones and digitally for Nintendo Wii in 2009. The Romancing SaGa 2 sequel game launched for Super Famicom in 1993. The remastered version of the game launched for PS4, PS Vita, Switch, Xbox One, and PC worldwide in December 2017.
